instruction: Configure VS Code to automatically format files on save and set the default formatter to Prettier.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to configure two VS Code settings: enable format on save and set the default formatter to Prettier. The evaluator reuses the existing check_json_settings function to verify both settings are correctly configured in the settings.json file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: format on save and default formatter
Getter logic correctly reads VS Code settings from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric function check_json_settings correctly compares JSON settings with proper parameter handling
Expected values are semantically correct: editor.formatOnSave=true and editor.defaultFormatter='esbenp.prettier-vscode'
Complete coverage: both requirements from instruction are checked
State accessibility is good: settings file is persisted and always accessible, no postconfig needed
Robust error handling for missing files, invalid JSON, and missing keys

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
